description: PJM seven-day load forecast — forecast electricity demand in MW by forecast area (each transmission zone plus the RTO total), hour by hour. Use for "what will PJM demand be tomorrow", "PJM peak forecast this week", capacity and demand-response planning. Requires a PJM API key.

_apiKey.description: PJM Data Miner 2 subscription key. Free at https://apiportal.pjm.com/.

forecast_area.description: Filter to one forecast area, e.g. "RTO_COMBINED", "PJM RTO", "BGE", "PEPCO".

name: pjm_load_forecast
title: Pjm Load Forecast
